scope: Offline hyena Walking on flat and synthetic slopes plus sampled native Wild Engine savanna and island-network mangrove terrain, three fixed root yaws; sampled points are not validated for navigation or obstacles; exact current CPU foot support is applied to original pose, while an experimental CPU reconstruction of interpolated baked matrices computes the same support correction. Compares all vertices with >50% foot/toe weight; mesh transforms still come from original evaluated rig. No actual GPU, animated morphs, irregular terrain, temporal sliding, collision/obstacles, runtime cost, simulation, image/video or other species.
